model_family: Paired Gaussian copula with separable exchangeable dependence, normal leptin_log10 margins, and lognormal positive endpoint margins

evidence_use.operator: arithmetic means and sample SDs on complete endpoint pairs
evidence_use.population: 44 completers aged 7-14 with simple obesity; before/after 3-month home diet/exercise program with professional follow-up; no randomized parallel arm; 43 glucose and triglyceride pairs.
evidence_use.measurement: units specified per endpoint; pediatric leptin already log10(pg/mL)
evidence_use.reason: Use every supplied marginal mean, sample SD, distribution and endpoint pair count as a same-population reconstruction input. Treat the rounded sample moments as plug-in population moments; finite synthetic samples fluctuate. For positive endpoints convert arithmetic mean and SD to lognormal parameters; leptin remains on the supplied log10 scale. These target-derived moments provide no independent validation or information about joint covariance.

evidence_use.population: 44 completers aged 7-14 with simple obesity; before/after 3-month home diet/exercise program with professional follow-up; no randomized parallel arm; 43 glucose and triglyceride pairs.
evidence_use.reason: Generate one wide paired record per synthetic person with both visits. At n=44 preserve 44 leptin and body-mass pairs and 43 glucose and triglyceride pairs, placing unavailable analysis pairs in the final row as required by the schema. For other n use round(endpoint_n*n/44) observed pairs and put the remainder last. Both-null representation describes unavailable complete pairs, not a claim about which original measurements were missing. The cohort is a single completer group; no untreated arm, age records, or causal treatment effect is fabricated.

components.name: Marginal measurement distributions
components.source_to_target_assumptions: Same-population A0 plug-in reconstruction. Normal leptin_log10 with supplied means/SDs; lognormal body_mass, glucose and triglycerides with exact population arithmetic moments equal to the supplied values. Lognormal log variance is log(1+(sd/mean)^2); log mean is log(mean)-log_variance/2. No realized marginal moment matching, target-dependent calibration or seed selection.

components.name: Separable paired Gaussian copula
components.source_to_target_assumptions: Assume latent within-endpoint pre/post correlation 0.80 and contemporaneous cross-endpoint correlation 0.25. Generate a pre endpoint vector from one shared and four endpoint-specific standard normals; generate an independent innovation vector with the same cross-endpoint structure; post=0.80*pre+sqrt(1-0.80^2)*innovation. This yields cross-endpoint/cross-visit latent correlation 0.20 and a positive definite covariance without specifying reserved observed-scale change correlations. These positive dependence assumptions are structural choices for a persistent paired cohort, not source estimates.

components.name: Complete-pair accounting and synthetic identity
components.source_to_target_assumptions: Exact scaled observed counts and declared schema order. New synthetic seed-prefixed identifiers have no connection to source participants. Rows are generated exchangeably before deterministic last-row analysis-pair masking, so the representation is independent of simulated measurements. This does not identify a clinical missingness mechanism. All randomness is local to numpy.random.default_rng(seed); evidence is read without mutation and the generator performs no I/O.

scenarios.assumption: One retained working joint model with latent temporal correlation 0.80 and exchangeable contemporaneous cross-endpoint correlation 0.25. All four endpoints share these dependence constants; no endpoint-specific covariance information is supplied.
scenarios.inclusion_rationale: A parsimonious positive definite model preserves paired persistence and permits nonzero shared endpoint variation while avoiding a claim that missing covariance evidence means independence. Equal treatment of endpoint dependence avoids unsupported endpoint-specific rankings. Numerical values are explicit unvalidated modeling choices. Allocation of twenty cohorts is a resource rule, not a posterior probability.
